name: 22_unscrew_bottle_cap
title: Unscrewing and Occluding Bottle Cap
summary: A dual-arm robot unscrews a soda bottle cap, occludes it under an arm, reveals it, and picks it up.
robot: two black robot arms with parallel grippers
setting: a laboratory desk with a white surface

segments.instruction: The top gripper twists the orange cap counterclockwise while the side arm holds the bottle steady.
The top gripper pulls the unscrewed cap upward, clearing the bottle neck.
The top gripper places the cap upright on the white table to the right and releases it.
The side arm extends its wrist forward, positioning its wide joint directly over the cap to block it from view.
segments.memory_event: hide: the orange cap is completely occluded from the overhead camera by the robot arm

segments.instruction: The top gripper hovers over the open bottle while the side arm remains stationary over the occluded cap.
The side arm retracts to its initial holding pose, clearing the space above the tabletop.
segments.memory_event: return: the orange cap reappears in the exact same spot and upright orientation on the white table

segments.instruction: The top gripper descends toward the cap and closes its fingers around it.
The top gripper lifts the cap from the table and aligns it above the mouth of the bottle.
